details: No pid_t/uid_t/gid_t/mode_t in public API; replaced with ProcessId/UserId/GroupId/FileModeBits aliases
No direct POSIX headers in public daemon header
No direct POSIX headers in server public header
unix_socket_permissions remains uint32_t and header has no POSIX type leak
No std::signal/::signal usage; runtime control polling uses SignalControl adapter
Legacy std::signal handlers removed; listener now installs/polls SignalControl
fork/waitpid/kill and related includes are constrained to Linux worker lifecycle paths
External process execution path remains POSIX and is wrapped in #ifndef _WIN32
getpwnam/getgrnam includes (<pwd.h>/<grp.h>) retained for Linux account validation only
